profile.headline: Software Engineer | C#/.NET, WPF, Robotics and Hardware Control | Semiconductor Equipment Integration | Software Architecture and Customer Escalations
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer specializing in C#/.NET development for industrial automation and semiconductor manufacturing equipment. My background spans Windows desktop applications, robotics, motion and hardware control, factory automation, and integration with manufacturing systems.

I work across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through implementation, testing, release, and long-term support. I’m particularly experienced in investigating complex problems that cross software, hardware, equipment, and external systems, including issues in customer production environments.

Beyond feature development, I contribute to software architecture, API design and governance, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, and improvements to engineering processes. I provide technical oversight for shared interfaces, mentor other developers, and work with globally distributed engineering teams.

My background began much closer to the hardware, building, configuring, and troubleshooting automated equipment before moving into software engineering. That experience continues to shape how I approach software: understanding not only the code, but the machine, the systems it communicates with, and the problem the customer is trying to solve.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
•	Design, develop, test, and maintain C#/.NET and WPF applications for Windows-based industrial automation and semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
•	Design and implement software integrations involving robotics, motion control, hardware interfaces, factory automation, MES, SECS/GEM, and customer APIs.
•	Own software features through the full development lifecycle, including requirements, architecture, design, implementation, testing, debugging, documentation, and release.
•	Provide technical oversight for a shared factory integration API, serving as a required reviewer for all changes to maintain architectural consistency, backward compatibility, and software quality.
•	Lead complex technical investigations involving interactions between software, hardware, automation systems, and manufacturing workflows, including customer production issues and escalations.
•	Work directly with customers, field service, applications, and engineering teams to troubleshoot equipment issues and translate manufacturing requirements into software solutions.
•	Contribute to software architecture, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, and development-process improvements for a large Windows desktop application.
•	Support other developers through design discussions, code reviews, troubleshooting, technical documentation, and interviews.
•	Collaborate with globally distributed software, hardware, QA, applications, and service teams to deliver and support production semiconductor manufacturing systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer, MTS
positions.description:
•	Developed custom software to interface Nordson robots with customer MES
•	Implemented factory integration system (FIS) API in robot control software
•	Coordinated software upgrades/installations with service teams and customers
•	Managed external development projects and developer training

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Technician
positions.description:
•	Oversaw the build process of robots and custom options ensuring customer requirements were met
•	Configured and wrote scripted routines for robots
•	Developed software tools to improve productivity of engineering staff and project managers
•	Assisted with the design, installation, and implementation of new options
•	Troubleshot software, firmware, and electronics circuits and implemented solutions to resolve issues
•	Communicated with field install/service teams to help troubleshoot issues at customer sites

positions.title: Machine Operator Cell Lead
positions.locationName: Dover, New Hampshire, United States · On-site
positions.description:
•	Oversaw operation and maintenance of robotics and blow-mold machines
•	Troubleshot hydraulics, pneumatics, and electronics
•	Inspected finished product and made software and hardware adjustments as necessary to meet product specifications
•	Performed preventive maintenance on line equipment and robot cells

positions.title: Ground Communications Repair Technician
positions.locationName: Camp Pendleton North, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
•	Managed IT helpdesk and field service dispatching
•	Accounted for and maintained over $5,000,000 worth of radio and computer assets
•	Troubleshot and repaired radio peripherals to component level
•	Troubleshot radio and computer circuit cards using oscilloscope, signal generator, multi-meter, and other testing equipment
•	Troubleshot computer and radio software
positions.insights: Microsoft Outlook, Electrical Troubleshooting and +17 skills
